import sys,json
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path("scripts/experiments").resolve()))
from audit_temporal_closeout import read_owner,disposition_row
from nisayon.engine.temporal_audit import exact_index
repo=Path.cwd()
coverage=json.loads(Path("docs/experiments/results/temporal-integration-001/frozen-audit-coverage.v1.json").read_text())
owner=Path("docs/evaluation/results/temporal-integration-001/followthrough/clock")
delivery="46a338677edcd452e7b18b2f99a06365dd4a3a40"
_,before=read_owner(repo,owner/"before/assessments.json",delivery,coverage,installed=False)
_,after=read_owner(repo,owner/"after/assessments.json",delivery,coverage,installed=True)
comparison=json.loads((owner/"comparison.json").read_text())
explanations={p["name"]:p for p in comparison["populations"]}
counts={}
for p in [*coverage["populations"],coverage["prefix_population"]]:
 rows=exact_index(explanations[p["owner_population"]]["rows"],[m["identity"] for m in p["members"]],key=lambda r:r["assignment_id"],scope=p["name"])
 for m in p["members"]:
  key=(p["name"],m["identity"])
  delta=disposition_row(m,before[key],after[key],rows[m["identity"]],p["name"])
  counts[p["name"]]=counts.get(p["name"],0)+bool(delta["predicate_changes"])
print(json.dumps({"owner_records":len(after),"predicate_changed_assignments":counts,"execution_performed":False}))
